howto.name: Upload WebP images
howto.text: Drop one or many .webp files up to 500 MB total.

howto.name: Choose page size
howto.text: Letter or A4. Transparency in WebP is rendered against a white page background.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: All images become one PDF in upload order. WebP's smaller size is reflected in a smaller PDF.

faq.q: Will the PDF be much smaller than from JPG?
faq.a: Slightly smaller — WebP-derived JPEGs inside PDF are similar to direct JPGs. The main benefit was at upload time (smaller WebP files).
Only the first frame is used. PDF doesn't support animation.
PDF supports transparency but most readers render text-on-transparency oddly. We default to compositing over white for best compatibility.
